Add prediction intervals to a mort_forecast

Source: R/workflow.R
add_pi.Rd

Computes bootstrap prediction intervals and attaches them to the forecast object.

Usage

add_pi(
  fc,
  n_sim = 500L,
  method = c("bootstrap", "gam_bayes"),
  cap = 1.5,
  calibration = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

fc

A mort_forecast object.

n_sim

Number of bootstrap simulations (default 500).

method

One of "bootstrap" (standard residual/ARIMA bootstrap) or "gam_bayes" (GAM posterior propagation). The latter requires that GAM fits are stored in the forecast extras.

cap

Maximum PI width on log scale (default 1.5).

calibration

Optional mort_calibration object (needed for "gam_bayes" method to access ensemble weights and GAM fits).

...

Ignored.

Value

An updated mort_forecast with mx_lower, mx_upper, mx_median filled in.
